scripts.dev: node scripts/build-blog.js && node scripts/apply-chrome.js && concurrently -k -n css,web -c cyan,magenta "npx @tailwindcss/cli -i ./styles/input.css -o ./styles/output.css --watch" "python3 -m http.server 3000"
scripts.build: node scripts/build-blog.js && node scripts/apply-chrome.js && npx @tailwindcss/cli -i ./styles/input.css -o ./styles/output.css --minify && node scripts/stamp-asset-versions.js
